# Temple Scroll Column 62 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 11Q19 (Cave 11), Col. 62 | **Condition:** well preserved

---

**62:1** If there is found in your midst, in one of your cities that I am giving to you, a man or a woman who does what is evil in my sight,

**62:2** by going and serving other gods and bowing down to them, whether to the sun or to the moon or to any of the host of the heavens,

**62:3** a thing which I have not commanded, and it is told to you and you hear of it,

**62:4** then you shall inquire diligently, and behold, the thing is true and certain — this abomination has been done in Israel —

**62:5** then you shall bring out that man or that woman who has done this evil thing to your gates, the man or the woman, and you shall stone them with stones and they shall die.

**62:6** On the mouth of two witnesses or on the mouth of three witnesses shall the one who is to die be put to death; he shall not be put to death on the mouth of one witness.

**62:7** The hand of the witnesses shall be upon him first to put him to death, and the hand of all the people afterward. And you shall purge the evil from your midst.

**62:8** If a matter is too difficult for you in judgment, between blood and blood, between plea and plea, between stroke and stroke — matters of dispute within your gates —

**62:9** then you shall arise and go up to the place that I shall choose, and you shall come to the Levitical priests and to the judge who shall be in those days,

**62:10** and you shall inquire, and they shall declare to you the word of judgment.

**62:11** And you shall act according to the word that they declare to you from that place which I shall choose, and you shall be careful to do according to all that they instruct you.

**62:12** According to the instruction that they instruct you and according to the judgment that they say to you, you shall do. You shall not turn aside from the word that they declare to you, to the right or to the left.

**62:13** And the man who acts presumptuously, so as not to listen to the priest who stands to minister there before me, or to the judge — that man shall die, and you shall purge the evil from Israel.

**62:14** And all the people shall hear and fear and shall not act presumptuously again.

**62:15** If you hear in one of your cities that I am giving you to dwell there, saying:

**62:16** Men, sons of Belial, have gone out from your midst and have led astray the inhabitants of their city, saying: Let us go and serve other gods whom you have not known —

---

*EMET notes: Column 62 reworks Deut 17:2–13 and begins Deut 13:12–18 (the apostate city). Divine first-person voice: "I am giving you" replaces "the LORD your God is giving you." "Sons of Belial" (בני בליעל) preserved as sectarian marker — this term carries heavy theological weight at Qumran. "On the mouth of" preserves Hebrew על פי for testimony.*
